planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno as specified; use A0 for analog thresholding and D13 for the LED output exactly as listed in the authoritative pin names.
No serial I/O, sensors (DHT/ultrasonic), displays, or actuators are explicitly wired in the provided requirements; therefore none are requested.
The business logic 'if A0 > 500 then LED on else off' is handled in the SysML model; the controller only updates these two ports each control step.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Analog value used to decide LED state (threshold > 500)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED on when A0 analog value > 500, otherwise off
